messages:
maya: quick flag: noticed EU stream route spiking in tokens-per-conn this morning, looks like duplicate accounting from reconnects during subprotocol negotiation.
jon: can you paste a short log?
maya: ```
[2026-01-05T08:12:01Z] proxy: conn=aa11 upgrade=start
[2026-01-05T08:12:01Z] backend: conn=aa11 recv=INIT missing-handshake
[2026-01-05T08:12:02Z] proxy: conn=aa11 retry-upgrade
[2026-01-05T08:12:02Z] backend: created partial-session pid=ps42
```
li: yep same pattern in canary. idea: add ephemeral handshake-id header `x-rw-ws-hid`, edge synthesizes if absent, accounting tags with hid and dedupes within 30s window.
maya: short-term I'm going to lower edge retry to 0 and set ws_upgrade_timeout=8s for EU. ops-bot can you apply?
ops-bot: applied: edge.eu.ws_upgrade_timeout=8s, edge.eu.proxy_retry_on_upgrade=false. Rollback in 10m available.
jon: please add a console metric `accounting.dedupe_hits` and a dashboard annotation. I'll review PR for handshake-id tomorrow.
maya: thanks — will log rollout plan in the runbook.
